general_tolerance: UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: THIRD ANGLE PROJECTION; DIMENSIONS IN INCHES; 2-PLACE DIM. ±.020; 3-PLACE DIM. ±.010; ANGULAR DIM. ±1°.

views.description: Longitudinal external view of the cylindrical backup: reduced, grooved left spigot and larger right-hand body. Axial blind tapped hole enters the right end.
views.centerline_notes: Horizontal centerline establishes the common turning axis. A short axial-position centerline marks the center of the circumferential groove. Dashed lines at the right end show the blind drilled/tapped hole and drill point.

views.description: Right end view showing the circular main body and central tapped hole; located to the right in third-angle projection.
views.centerline_notes: Orthogonal centerlines intersect at the common center of the body and tapped hole. Reduced spigot and groove lie behind the main body and are not separately depicted in this view.

dimensions.notes: Printed 4.250; from left spigot end to right body end. General three-place tolerance applies.
Left end to main-body shoulder; general three-place tolerance.
Printed '.062 CENT.'; interpreted as the narrow groove-root width centered on the groove centerline, not the width including the sloping flanks. General three-place tolerance.
Printed .250; groove center is this distance to the left of the main-body shoulder. General three-place tolerance.
Axial distance from left end face to end of lead-in chamfer. General three-place tolerance.
Explicit +.000/-.002; permissible limits 1.245–1.247. Overrides general tolerance.

Printed value is clear. Interpreted as groove-root diameter. Extension lines are close to the left-end chamfer-tip level; confirm feature association before manufacture rather than also imposing this diameter on the tip. General three-place tolerance.
30° upper angular callout. Value and tolerances are in DEGREES; schema unit field cannot represent degrees. General angular tolerance ±1°.

Separate lower '30° TYP.' callout for sloping transitions, interpreted to cover groove flanks. Value and tolerances are in DEGREES, not inches; unit field is schema-limited. Confirm typical scope with radius callout.
Printed '.030 R. TYP.'; leader points to reduced-diameter/main-body shoulder transition. General three-place tolerance. All additional locations covered by TYP are not individually identified.

Exact callout '#10-32 TAP .38 DEEP'. Numeric value .190 is the nominal major diameter associated with #10, not a printed decimal diameter or tap-drill diameter. 32 threads/inch; ordinarily a UNF size, but series and fit class are not explicitly printed. Do not apply general decimal tolerance to thread major diameter.
Printed .38 DEEP following TAP; specifies tapped depth, not independently specified drill-point depth. General two-place tolerance.
Derived nominal: D001 - D002 = 4.250 - .562 = 3.688. Not independently toleranced; worst-case stack of parent tolerances is ±.020.
Derived nominal: D002 - D004 = .562 - .250 = .312. Not independently toleranced; worst-case stack of parent tolerances is ±.020.
Derived nominal: (D006 - D007)/2 = (1.247 - 1.188)/2 = .0295. Conditional on D007 being the groove-root diameter. Parent diameter tolerances govern.

features.description: Base main cylinder, diameter 2.000 and derived axial length 3.688. For axial coordinates measured from left tip, extends from x=.562 to x=4.250.
Coaxial reduced spigot, diameter 1.247 +.000/-.002, projecting .562 leftwards from the main-body shoulder; start with sharp junctions before finishing features.

SUBTRACTIVE 360-degree revolved annular groove in spigot, not an additive revolve. Groove center .250 left of shoulder; .062 centered root flat; interpreted root diameter 1.188 and 30-degree flanks. Confirm root-diameter association and typical blend scope before finalizing profile.

Coaxial blind tap preparation drilled from right end. Drill diameter, cylindrical drilling depth, and point angle are not specified. Do not use nominal thread major diameter .190 as a prescribed tap-drill diameter or .38 as the complete drill-point depth.
Internal #10-32 thread, .38 deep from right end; fit class unspecified. Can be represented as a cosmetic tapped-hole feature pending manufacturing drill details.
Circumferential lead-in on left spigot end, .094 axial extent and 30 degrees to shaft axis. Do not infer another tip diameter by scaling the image.
.030 R TYP transition blends; shoulder fillet is directly indicated. Additional edges covered by TYP require confirmation; do not indiscriminately round every edge.

symmetry.plane: Any longitudinal plane through the shaft axis
symmetry.description: Nominal turned envelope and axial drill are rotationally symmetric. Actual helical thread and stamped lettering are excluded.

symmetry.plane: Transverse plane at the groove center, .250 left of body shoulder
symmetry.description: '.062 CENT.' establishes centered root flat; groove flanks are interpreted as paired typical 30-degree transitions.

concentric_groups.description: Main cylinder, reduced spigot, annular groove, central tapped hole, lead-in chamfer and shoulder blend share the drawn shaft centerline. No numerical coaxiality tolerance is specified.

dimension_chains.description: Overall length = spigot projection + body length: 4.250 = .562 + 3.688.
Spigot length = left end to groove center + groove center to shoulder: .562 = .312 + .250.

warnings: No ASME/ANSI/ISO/DIN standard is explicitly named. Third-angle projection and inch units are explicitly stated; do not equate these alone with an identified standard.
Revision and surface finish are not specified. Model No. is 220 B; this is not the drawing revision. Drawing date is March 27, 1979; drawn by T. Choo.
Material note reads 4150, R/C 40-45. Heat-treatment procedure is not given.
Additional instruction: STAMP "SB-12008" on the main body's cylindrical exterior. Character size, depth, orientation, and exact placement are not dimensioned; this is not a surface-finish callout.

The 1.188 diameter is interpreted as the groove-root diameter. Its extension lines are near the left-end chamfer-tip level in this scan; confirm this association before manufacture. The printed number itself is legible.
Applying .094 axial extent and 30 degrees to the lead-in gives a nominal tip diameter approximately 1.1385, not 1.188. Consequently, do not also constrain the tip to 1.188 without clarification.

The .062 CENT. dimension is interpreted as the centered groove-root flat width. The 30-degree TYP and .030 R TYP notes do not individually label every affected edge; verify intended transition/blend scope before generating the final groove profile.
Tapped-hole diameter .190 is nominal #10 major diameter, not a specified drill size. Hole depth .38 is tap depth. Tap-drill diameter/depth, thread class, and drill-point angle are absent.

Hole instance coordinate [1,1] is in the right-end-view bounding box, whose lower-left is the corner of the 2.000-diameter circle's enclosing square. Centering is established by the drawn centerlines, not separately printed coordinate dimensions.
Angular values and their tolerances are in degrees despite the schema's inch-only-compatible unit enumeration.
No datum symbols, geometric feature-control frames, or reference dimensions are shown.
